CustomField.label: Display: Found Text
CustomField.description: Optional and display only. Plain text (not a formula) that replaces the Found line the Framework writes on a Query, Formula, or Compare two queries check, including the auto-generated "N of M records did not pass" summary on a multi-row ("Every record passes") query check. An Apex check writes its own Found value, so this field does not apply there. Supports {!rhcResult.foundValue}, {!rhcResult.failedRecordCount}, and {!rhcResult.totalRecordCount} plus {!record.FieldName} tokens. Example: {!rhcResult.failedRecordCount} of {!rhcResult.totalRecordCount} contacts missing email.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Display only. Plain text (not a formula) for the "Found" line. Tokens: {!rhcResult.foundValue}, {!rhcResult.failedRecordCount}, {!rhcResult.totalRecordCount}, {!record.FieldName}.
